test_title: PYST 4: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Thirty-nine Science students of class XII were seated in a row in an auditorium. Roshan was 12th from the front. What was his position from the end?
solution:
Total number of Science students = 39

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ac75b51daf8c9b47845ac351bde76c0d8b0ee2299ec244a858aa97715199eaf.png] 

Roshan position from front = 12

Roshan position from end = Total number of Science students - Roshan position from the front + 1

= 39 - 12 + 1

= 28th

Hence, **Roshan is 28th from the end.**
